mutations.label: ADR-139 T1: slices follow the given order, not the sorted one
mutations.from: return sorted.filter((_, at) => at % n === i - 1)
mutations.to: return files.filter((_, at) => at % n === i - 1)
mutations.only: ^every test file is in exactly one slice, whatever the platform or the order given$

mutations.label: ADR-139 T1: an off-by-one stride loses a slice
mutations.from: return sorted.filter((_, at) => at % n === i - 1)
mutations.to: return sorted.filter((_, at) => at % n === i % n)
mutations.only: ^every test file is in exactly one slice, whatever the platform or the order given$
